title: anthoxanthum australe
intro: Anthoxanthum australe, commonly known as Austral grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthoxanthum australe include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
